metaDescription: Tell us why you removed TabMerger. One optional question.
title: TabMerger was removed
lead: Sorry to see you go. If you have a minute, tell us why. It is one optional question, and every answer helps us make TabMerger better.
addBack: You can add TabMerger back at any time.
dataNote: The tabs and groups saved in TabMerger on this browser were removed along with it. Backup files saved to your Downloads folder are still there, and if you used cloud sync, your synced groups are still in your account.
billingNote: Removing TabMerger does not cancel a Pro subscription. To cancel it, sign in to your account and choose Manage billing.
helpNote: Need help, or want to talk to a person? <link>Contact us</link>.

form.question: Why did you remove TabMerger?
form.pickMany: Pick as many as you like.

reasons.hard-to-use: It was confusing or hard to use
reasons.missing-feature: It is missing something I need
reasons.price: The paid plans cost too much
reasons.temporary: I am reinstalling or it is only temporary
